document: F11 ECONOMICS AUDIT — reconciled costs + forward budget to complete (~60 min, 49 scenes).

CONFIRMED_paid.basis: ODG-side ledgers (reserve-before-call, settle-to-worst-case). minimax returns no per-call price → booked at verified worst-case; not a third-party invoice. Provider-side billing not independently confirmed (no invoice access) — flagged.

billingCaveat: spent = ledger worst-case bookings, which can never UNDER-count. Independent provider invoice NOT available in-repo → amounts are ledger-confirmed, not invoice-confirmed.

t2State.note: T2 hard cap €10; DO NOT exceed; €1 remaining; 16 attempts left.

rawVsUsable.note: raw includes pilot/av/benchmark TEST clips. F11-USABLE placed = 24 clips across 13 scenes. NONE human-ACCEPTED yet. assembled preview = 214.58s (incl. placeholders) — NOT 214s of finished film.

costPerUnit_EUR.note: T2 clips all decode-clean + usable (authored single-subject, 15/15). per-finished-minute: see forward scenarios /60.

forwardBudget_toComplete_EUR.assumptions: remaining = planned video/still minus produced; video €0.60 (proven T2), still €0.03, voice €14.10 (141 lines), music €0 CC0, +15% margin; reuse factor reduces unique video gens; retry = 1/accept. T2 showed HIGH accept on authored single-subject → OPTIMISE end is realistic IF prompts are authored.

grandTotal_filmEstimate_EUR.note: T2 cap €10 is NOT the film budget. Forward spend needs NEW authorization beyond T2.

sensitivity: cost scales ~1/accept and ~1/reuse. If accept drops 0.90→0.60: forward +~50%. If reuse 1.5→1.1: forward +~35%. Dominant unknowns: accept rate at scale + how many planned shots truly need video vs reuse/stills.

optimizations.detail: authored single-subject prompts gave 15/15 accept in T2 (no retries) — authoring BEFORE paying is the single biggest saving vs blind generation
shot-readiness blocks multi-char/VFX/new-char/unknown BEFORE any reserve (driver readyGate blocks 300+)
232 planned stills at €0.03 vs €0.60 video — use stills where motion not required
a 6s clip can serve >1 edit position (proven on A1b)
author one character per shot, cut together — unblocks multi-char scenes without a multi-identity capability
optimizations.risk: staging decision reserved to CTO for some scenes

unproven: accept rate at scale beyond the small authored T2 sample
exact shot count needing video vs reuse/still
final audio licensing cost (CC0 not yet sourced; pro mix possibly human/out-of-scope)
